ChangeNotes.Value: v1.2.0 - THE OFFICERS UPDATE. Your officers now own the drill: the Quartermaster's Leadership sets how much XP the troops keep (a master earns BONUS XP; the First Mate takes over at sea), the Surgeon's Medicine decides the fallen's fate (a few wake wounded - and in unlucky cases a man truly dies; a good doctor helps a lot, and deaths can be turned fully off), and choosing the battlefield or a non-daylight hour in a REAL battle must now be EARNED by out-scouting the enemy (the Navigator at sea; full daylight and the campaign clock always free). Mock-enemy training is on by default; sea drills cost double wages; 'Choose the time of day' from a menu now applies to ONE battle only - the standing default lives in MCM; every officer got its own MCM group; and a debug log ledger for easy bug reports.
